figures.caption: Figure 1: Regression experiment setup for predicting continuous valence and arousal scores, including the model hidden layers (h1 – h3) and the included feature sets.

Table 3: Arousal regression results (CCC mean ±1 standard deviation). The top three feature combinations based on train+val performance are reported along with the individual features and combinations of all text and all audio features. CF - SF is the average performance gain for using colloquial instead of standardized text transcripts († marks significant difference at p < 0.05; paired t-test). CF and SF text samples are marked with ° and *, respectively. Footnote T marks text-based and A audio-based features. Ann. SD refers to test set CCC variability across individual annotators.
